translations.web: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
translations.bsb: Is your reverence not your confidence, and the uprightness of your ways your hope?
translations.kjv: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
translations.asv: Is not thy fear of God thy confidence, And the integrity of thy ways thy hope?
